body:
Hi team,

Exporting the Weekly Funnel dashboard to CSV spins for a few minutes and then fails with "Request timed out". Screenshot attached.

Priya Raman
Data Platform Lead, Lumen Analytics

Hi Priya,

We raised the export timeout for large dashboards; the Weekly Funnel export now completes in about 40 seconds. Marking this as solved, but reply here if it comes back.

Sam

Hello, my card payment for this invoice failed twice. I attached the invoice. Can you tell me what's wrong?

Priya Ramesh
Ramesh & Co Bakery
Hi Priya, the card on file expired in September. You can update it under Settings > Billing and we'll retry the charge automatically.

Hi,

Our October bill is about 30% higher than September and I can't see why. We haven't added any seats.

Priya Raman
Data Platform Lead, Lumen Analytics
Hi Priya, happy to look into it. Could you send us a copy of the invoice you're looking at so we can compare line items?

Hi, our accounting team needs a PDF copy of the September invoice. Could you send one over?

Thanks,
Tom Becker
Finance, Lumen Analytics
Hi Tom, the September invoice is attached.

Since this afternoon our team can't sign in with SSO: after Okta we land back on the sign-in page. I've attached a HAR capture from Chrome.

Priya Raman
Data Platform Lead, Lumen Analytics
Thanks Priya. The HAR shows the SAML response is missing the email attribute. Could you check the attribute mapping in your Okta app and let us know?

The shipment tracking widget on our order page just shows a spinner since yesterday.

Grace Liu
Harbor Freight Co
